AttentionProbesTotal.meaning: attention-side probes measured on at least 5 clearing models

AttentionProbesInBasis.meaning: of those the pre-registered basis declares

AttentionProbesOutsideBasis.meaning: of those the basis does not declare, so they sit outside the ranking

AttentionProbesBestOutside.meaning: best mean AUROC among the probes outside the basis, before_attention_gaussian

AttentionProbesBestOutsideName.meaning: the probe outside the basis with the highest mean AUROC

AttentionProbesBeatingRecommended.meaning: probes outside the basis whose mean AUROC exceeds the recommended placement

AttentionHeadMaskAuroc.meaning: mean AUROC of masking whole attention heads at the adaptive rule

AttentionHeadMaskN.meaning: clearing models carrying the head-masking probe

AttentionHeadMaskTprTen.meaning: mean TPR of head masking at a 10% false-positive budget
